campbell.title: Campbell City Council — July 7, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council is holding public hearings on renewing an interim zoning ordinance tied to state Senate Bill implementation, and on revoking the business licenses and tobacco retailer permits for two local shops, California Cigar and Hayes Smoke Shop. The council will also vote on applying for a regional transportation grant and approving new consultant service agreements for city projects.
keyTopics: Renewal of interim ordinance implementing state Senate Bill housing/zoning requirements
Revocation of business license and tobacco permit for California Cigar
Revocation of business license and tobacco permit for Hayes Smoke Shop
Application for a One Bay Area Grant to fund public works projects
Approval of new consultant service agreements

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — May 6, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council is moving forward with the annual process to renew a special assessment district, including preliminary approval of the Engineer's Report and a public hearing before final adoption. The Council also discussed whether Saratoga should consider becoming a charter city and reviewed early estimates of possible new local tax options and how much revenue they could raise.
keyTopics: Preliminary approval of the Engineer's Report for the assessment district budget
Resolution of Intention and public hearing on the assessment renewal
Ordinance scheduled for formal adoption at the May 20, 2026 meeting
Discussion of charter city status and what it would mean for Saratoga
Early estimates of potential new local tax measures and projected revenue

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — April 21, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council met to handle routine business, including approving prior meeting minutes and reviewing the town's February 2026 financial report. The Council also considered a construction contract with QLM, Inc., a public improvements resolution, a new three-year professional services agreement, and a contract amendment, and held a court-ordered hearing on pending appeals.
keyTopics: February 2026 monthly financial and investment report
Construction contract award to QLM, Inc.
Resolution directing preparation of town improvement plans
New three-year professional services agreement and a second contract amendment
Court-ordered hearing on appeals raised by a member of the public

san-jose.title: San José City Council — June 23, 2026
san-jose.summary: San José's City Council met to consider designating a historic property at 647 South Sixth Street as a city landmark with a Mills Act tax incentive contract, along with a potential ballot measure on ranked-choice voting for filling vacant Mayor or Council seats. The council also reviewed a large advertising sign contract for the airport and a long-term power purchase agreement with an energy supplier.
keyTopics: Historic landmark designation and Mills Act property tax contract for 647 South Sixth Street
Proposed November 2026 ballot measure allowing ranked-choice voting to fill Mayor or Council vacancies
Contract award for large format advertising signage at San José Mineta International Airport
Long-term power purchase agreement with Shell Energy North America
Public comment process and multilingual translation access for the meeting

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — June 23, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council met to handle several honorary recognitions alongside key budget and infrastructure decisions. The Council reviewed the city's spending limit and financial policies for the coming fiscal year, approved a major capital projects plan, and discussed long-term water supply planning. They also closed the meeting with a private legal session about potential lawsuits facing the city.
keyTopics: Closed-door discussion on potential litigation facing the city (two possible cases)
Proclamations honoring National Immigrant Heritage Month, the Kiwanis Club's 100th anniversary, and City Attorney Jennifer Logue's judicial appointment
Setting the city's legal spending limit and updating financial/budget policies for 2026-27
Adopting the 5-year Urban Water Management and Water Shortage Contingency Plans
Approving the 2026-27 Capital Improvement Program, including work on the Public Safety Building, Shoreline Golf Links parking lot repaving, and South Bay Salt Pond Restoration project

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — July 28, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: Sunnyvale's City Council held a closed session followed by a study session focused on updating the city's artificial turf policy, likely covering sports fields and parks. Council also handled routine business, including approving bill payments, amending a landfill services contract, and placing unpaid utility charges onto residents' property tax bills for the coming fiscal year.
keyTopics: Artificial Turf Policy Study Update (study session)
Amendment to landfill services agreement with SCS Field Services, Inc.
Delinquent utility charges to be added to property tax bills for 2026/27
Routine approval of city bills and claims payments
Closed session held ahead of the public study session

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — July 21, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met privately with its lawyers to discuss three ongoing lawsuits against the city, so no public votes or policy decisions were made during this closed-door session. The cases involve disputes over housing development, land use, and street safety issues.
keyTopics: Lawsuit: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety v. City of Cupertino
Closed-session legal strategy discussion with city attorneys
No public action taken during this closed session

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — June 9, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council held a public hearing to finalize the city's budget plans, including a two-year construction and infrastructure spending plan for 2026-27 and 2027-28. Council members also reviewed and approved updates to the current year's operating budget, along with separate budgets for the city's Housing Authority and Sports and Open Space Authority.
keyTopics: Adoption of the FY 2026/27 & FY 2027/28 Capital Improvement Program budget (funding for roads, buildings, and other public infrastructure projects)
Approval of amendments to the FY 2026/27 general operating budget
Adoption of the FY 2026/27 Housing Authority budget
Adoption of the FY 2026/27 Sports and Open Space Authority budget

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — April 7, 2026
milpitas.summary: Milpitas City Council will review proposed changes to how federal housing and community development funds are allocated for 2025-2026, consider new project ideas suggested by individual councilmembers, and discuss shortening the process for filling a vacant council seat. Routine business like approving past meeting minutes and previewing upcoming agenda items will also be handled.
keyTopics: Proposed changes to the 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and 2025-2026 funding allocations for housing/community development
New project and policy ideas submitted by individual councilmembers for future work
Proposal to change the process and timeline for filling City Council vacancies
Approval of minutes from previous council meetings
Preview of topics expected at the next council meeting

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto City Council — July 8, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The City Council opened with a routine Director's Report covering upcoming meeting schedules and assignments, then held a public hearing on a rezoning request for 470 Olive Avenue. The proposal would change the property from single-family residential zoning to medium-density mixed-use zoning, aligning it with the neighboring parcel at 2951 El Camino Real, as part of a broader update to the North Ventura area's land use plan.
keyTopics: Director's Report on meeting schedule and council assignments
Public hearing on rezoning 470 Olive Avenue from single-family residential (NV-R1) to medium-density mixed use (NV-MXM)
Proposed update to the North Ventura Coordinated Area Plan land use designation
Aligning zoning with the adjacent parcel at 2951 El Camino Real
Potential increase in housing density near North Ventura neighborhood
